text:
Gold Price in 1973
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1973, the LBMA gold price rose 70.1% between 1973-01-31 ($66.00) and 1973-12-31 ($112). The highest sampled price was $123 in June and the lowest was $66.00 in January. The mean of these observations was $100. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
